donors.notes: Root terms are not reduced to a blanket Apache-only claim. Representative PSI and indexing source headers at the pinned revision state Apache-2.0.
Pinned source is treated as donor code, not as a claim about current hosted/commercial Continue behavior.

Core indexer imports @augmentcode/auggie-sdk and uses API credentials/network behavior; abstractions and orchestration are separable donor candidates, hosted context execution is not admitted by this audit.

components.componentSummary: Common program-structure element abstraction spanning language, tree navigation, source ranges, references, navigation/original elements and mutation-oriented PSI contracts.
components.expectedBenefit: Establish a language-neutral semantic node model richer than raw AST nodes and suitable for navigation/refactoring/context evidence.
components.benchmarkNeed: semantic query latency and cross-language correctness
components.notes: Do not reproduce IntelliJ object graph wholesale; port concepts into a Kodac-owned language-neutral contract with provenance/freshness identity.

components.componentSummary: Project/file indexing API with indexable-file iteration, keyed value/file queries, modification stamps, rebuild/reindex semantics, scoped processing and explicit large-project/read-action constraints.
components.kodacTargetSubsystem: K3 / Kodac Context Fabric incremental semantic index
components.expectedBenefit: Mature index lifecycle/query semantics and awareness of large-project consistency/cancellation tradeoffs.
components.benchmarkNeed: cold index, incremental update, query latency, memory, stale/rebuild correctness
components.notes: Kodac version should preserve exact revision/provenance and isolate all indexing writes behind bounded authority.

components.componentSummary: Refactoring factory/contracts identified for deeper audit of safe rename/move/extract/change-signature style operations and transactional change planning.
components.expectedBenefit: Move Kodac from text patching toward semantics-aware refactor plans with preconditions and change sets.
components.notes: Any eventual writes remain K2-mediated; the audit does not grant refactor execution authority.

components.componentSummary: Inspection-extension model identified as a donor for language-aware diagnostics, problem descriptors, quick-fix separation and extension composition.
components.expectedBenefit: Unified diagnostics contract that can feed KRI as evidence without making inspections completion authority.
components.notes: Quick fixes must be separated from finding production and remain write-authority constrained.

components.componentSummary: Typed extension-point registration/lifecycle design identified for Kodac plugin/skill/provider extensibility study.
components.expectedBenefit: Stable extension contracts while keeping plugin capability grants explicit rather than ambient.
components.benchmarkNeed: extension discovery/load overhead and failure isolation
components.notes: Kodac must add capability/security boundaries beyond ordinary IDE extension loading.

components.componentSummary: ILLM contract combines complete/chat/stream/FIM/embed/rerank/token-count/model-list and capability predicates, with provider/model/config fields.
components.expectedBenefit: Accelerate model-agnostic interfaces and capability negotiation across chat/completion/FIM/embedding/reranking.
components.benchmarkNeed: provider parity, streaming correctness, cancellation, token accounting
components.notes: Do not copy ambient apiKey/apiBase/fetch authority into the trust core; Kodac must inject transport through explicit capability boundaries.

components.componentSummary: Provider/model autodetection logic with an adjacent regression suite.
components.expectedBenefit: Reduce manual provider configuration and improve model capability discovery.
components.notes: Requires a later bounded network/credential execution gate before behavior can run.

components.componentSummary: Token counting/budgeting utilities with extensive tests and model-specific accounting concerns.
components.expectedBenefit: Faster reliable prompt/context budgeting across models.
components.notes: Prefer small, test-backed utilities rather than whole LLM stack import.

components.componentSummary: Context provider descriptions, query/submenu modes, selected-code inputs and indexing-dependent context interfaces.
components.kodacTargetSubsystem: K3 / Kodac Context Fabric Provider Registry
components.expectedBenefit: A practical provider ecosystem model for context sources while Kodac adds provenance, bounds and exact-head identity.
components.notes: Continue exposes fetch/IDE directly to provider extras; Kodac should replace these ambient objects with scoped capabilities.

components.licenseClass: Apache-2.0 repository license observed; component headers/dependencies to audit
components.componentSummary: Three product surfaces for VS Code, JetBrains and CLI demonstrate a shared-core/multi-host pattern.
components.expectedBenefit: Fast path to meeting developers inside existing IDEs while native Kodac IDE matures.
components.notes: Do not copy host-side write/process authority without mapping every operation into Kodac capability/K2 boundaries.

components.licenseClass: MIT repository license observed; dependencies to audit
components.componentSummary: Architecture separates content Sources, persisted IndexStores and client exposure surfaces, enabling multiple acquisition/persistence/use combinations.
components.expectedBenefit: Clear connector boundary for GitHub/GitLab/Bitbucket/web/filesystem-style sources and multiple storage/client surfaces.
components.benchmarkNeed: connector correctness, incremental freshness, storage portability
components.notes: Port interfaces first; authorize concrete connectors separately according to their network/credential/write authority.

components.componentSummary: Orchestrates previous-state loading, source change detection, full fallback, added/modified/removed updates, metadata refresh and state persistence.
components.kodacTargetSubsystem: K3 / Kodac Context Fabric Incremental Indexer
components.expectedBenefit: Mature full-vs-incremental state machine and deletion correctness for context refresh.
components.benchmarkNeed: incremental correctness, deletion handling, no-change fast path, restart/recovery
components.notes: Current implementation reads API tokens/environment and calls DirectContext network operations; port only the orchestration/state model into a Kodac-local engine.

components.componentSummary: File filtering primitive with an adjacent test suite, useful for excluding unsuitable context inputs.
components.expectedBenefit: Accelerate safe generated/binary/ignored-file filtering before indexing.
components.benchmarkNeed: false include/exclude corpus including secrets/generated/binary edge cases
components.notes: Audit exact filtering semantics/tests before direct source intake.

components.componentSummary: Index state/result/file-entry contracts supporting full and incremental connector workflows.
components.expectedBenefit: Speed definition of typed connector state without coupling Kodac to hosted engine state formats.
components.notes: Re-own all state identities under Kodac provenance/freshness semantics.
